titulo.alumno:
«Новостная заметка и недостающий контекст»
Brief news item and missing context

intro: A news item summarises an event but may omit background, method or the people affected; identify what is claimed and what information is missing.

Check whether the outlet links to the original document and whether the figures have a clear period and reference.
